extra.catchMessage: A squid wriggles up with your line.
Something soggy climbs out of the water: a Sea Walker.
The dark water stirs - a Night Squid rises.
A Sea Guardian blinks at you from the deep.
You spilled a Sea Witch's cauldron. She is not pleased.
A Sea Archer surfaces with its bow already drawn.
A Deep Rider gallops out of the waves.
Is that a cat? A Catfish!
A slimy Sea Leech latches onto your hook.
A Guardian Defender rises to protect its waters.
The Deep Sea Protector wakes from its long sleep!
Three heads break the surface - the Water Hydra wants a fight.
The sea itself bows as the Tidelord rises.
A crowned rabbit hops out of the water. The Carrot Monarch has arrived!
Your chumcap bucket rattles - a Mooshroom Diver surfaces.
A drenched Oasis Rabbit paddles to shore.
A very wet Oasis Sheep climbs out of the pool.
A small Ore Grubber wriggles out of the quarry water.
A medium Ore Grubber wriggles out of the quarry water.
A large Ore Grubber wriggles out of the quarry water.
A bloated Ore Grubber wriggles out of the quarry water.
A Water Worm burrows out of the cave pool.
A Poisoned Water Worm oozes up from the depths.
An Abyssal Miner smashes its way out of the water!
A Flaming Worm wriggles out of the magma.
A Lava Blaze climbs out of the molten rock.
A Lava Pigman snorts its way out of the lava!
A Magma Slug oozes out of the lava.
A long moo echoes from the lava. A Magma Cow!
A small but nasty Lava Leech grabs your line.
The heat spikes as a Pyroclastic Worm surfaces.
A Lava Flame shoots out of the lava!
A Fire Eel coils out of the molten depths.
Taurus charges out of the lava on his burning steed!
The ground shakes. Thunder rolls up out of the lava.
You have angered something ancient... Lord Gnashmaw rises from the lava!
WHOA! A Phlegmburst gurgles up from the pool.
Smells like dinner. It's a Fried Chicken!
Ouch, that's hot! You reeled in a Volcanic Snail.
Something's brewing in the lava: a Fireproof Witch!
A Magma Pillar towers up out of the lava.
A Fiery Scuttler sidles up to you... with friends.
The sky darkens and the lava boils. Ragnarok has come.
Half frog, half man, all trouble - it's Frog Man!
A tiny Inkspawn squirts out of the hotspot.
A very angry Snapping Turtle is coming your way!
A Manta Ray glides up out of the hotspot.
Bright rings flash beneath you - a Blue Ringed Octopus!
The water froths and a Tiki Totem lurches out. You will pay for this!
The Trash Gobbler is hungry, and you look edible.
A Dumpster Diver crawls out of the bayou muck.
A mournful wail drifts over the swamp. A Banshee!
A wobbling heap of swamp gunk rises: the Bayou Sludge!
A long snout cuts through the water. Alligator!
The water bulges for twenty blocks. A Titanoboa uncoils!
A Bogged staggers out of the marsh, dripping moss.
Look up! A Wetwing shakes itself dry above you.
A whole gang of tadpoles swarms your bobber!
An Ent, old as the marsh itself, rises from the reeds.
The Loch Sovereign rises, crowned in weed.
Ripples, then a long neck... the Loch Wyrm is real!
A Lava Strider surfs your line right out of the vent.
A curious Atoll Croaker gulps down your bait.
A Lotus Guardian stands up out of the lagoon.
What is THAT? A... Grof?
A Drowned Captain seizes your bobber!
A Puddle Jumper is getting ready to leap - cast your rod into it and hold on tight!
Kneel before the Frog Prince... or else!
A Haggard staggers up the bank, spoiling for a fight!
A Saltling cuts you off with a stream of bubbles!
A Sprawl unfolds out of the blue, and it has seen you.
Laughter skims across the water - a Torrid!
Something zips over the springs - a Silkdrift!
A Giant Isopod is dredged up out of the depths!
A Frozen Wanderer thaws out of the pond after years under the ice.
It's a snowman! He seems friendly enough.
A Gift Goblin is running off with the presents - catch him!
A forgotten Nutcracker marches up from under the ice.
What in the world is THAT? A Yeti!
Ice cracks and a Frost Drake takes shape from the depths.
Look out! Hopping Jack bounces at you.
Phew, only a Scarecrow.
Hooves thud under the waves. A Nightmare surfaces.
The moon is full... a Werewolf leaps out!
The ghost of a long-drowned fisher has come for its rod.
No... death itself rises from the water!
A small fin pokes out of the water: a Nurse Shark.
A fin as blue as the sea - a Blue Shark!
A striped hunter bursts from the deep: Tiger Shark!
A Great White Shark has your scent, and it is hungry!
